rule: A task is failing until its check passes, run by the evaluator. Budget: the owners named, their tests and the docs; past it, a decision record.

tasks.title: Decision: interfaces.ts owns the interface record, the negative and its tables; rows in CLAUDE.md and OWNERS.md
tasks.check: the routing test passes with interfaces.ts named; the decision record exists

tasks.title: The Interface record, and every part's interfaces read from its ports, old interfaces, bore and shaft (no part changed)
tasks.check: for every starter board's things, each port and old interface gives exactly one interface with a stable id; ids unchanged across two builds

tasks.title: The tables negatives need, each row sourced: ISO 273 fine and coarse (and M24), tap drills (ISO 2306 or derived d − P), counterbores (DIN 974-1), countersinks (ISO 15065), engagement (VDI 2230 or typical), edge and spacing (EN 1993-1-8 t. 3.3, checked), ISO 286-1 tolerance formulas (derived)
tasks.check: every row carries a source or a label; spot values agree with their source, checked by the evaluator against the source itself

tasks.title: Cuts as solids: a lathe-profile cut (counterbore, countersink, drill point) in brep.ts and in the views' drill; Keep as a cylinder
tasks.check: a counterbored hole's volume equals its profile's volume of revolution within 0.1 %; the solid is valid; STEP reads back the same volume

tasks.title: negativeOf: the mirror interface and the tool bodies (remove, keep, add, contact), by the host's material (insert for plastics, pilot for wood)
tasks.check: evaluation cases 1, 2, 3, 7 give their expected numbers

tasks.title: imprint: stand an interface on any surface point (normal, edge rule, turn)
tasks.check: on a box's top, a cylinder's side and a sloped face, the frame's n is within 0.5° of the surface normal and the hole lies where pointed within 0.1 mm

tasks.title: The checks before cutting (wall, depth, spacing, room, breaking in), each refusing with its rule, its numbers and its source
tasks.check: evaluation cases 2, 4, 5 are refused with the right rule and value; case 1 passes

tasks.title: Apply: cut, add the keep zones, give the host the mirror interface and the imprint record
tasks.check: after an imprint, the host's new interface finds a fastener by fit() (the hole finds its bolt)

tasks.title: Face queries: an imprint keeps to its face by what the face is (made by, normal and extreme, near); said lost, never moved
tasks.check: evaluation case 10: a box made taller keeps its imprint on the top; a face removed says the imprint is lost

tasks.title: fastenerFor: the fastener from the catalogue for a stack (through, tapped, insert), said why; mate() lays every fastener through it; boreThrough's 0.5 mm replaced by the standard
tasks.check: evaluation case 8 chooses the expected bolt; the engine's fasteners are unchanged or better, compared before and after

tasks.title: Copy and paste an interface; pattern and relation nodes; a shared pattern read by both parts
tasks.check: evaluation case 9: the bore widened, the bolt circle, the bolts and the cover's holes follow; the run log names each step

tasks.title: Joints: frame-to-frame joints solved together; residual, flipped, freedom left (Jacobian rank), the fewest that fight named
tasks.check: a flipped part is reported; a motor on four holes has 0 freedom left; a hinge has 1; two fighting joints are named

tasks.title: The nodes (interfaces, negative, imprint, pattern, relation, joint, assert) with their own tests; starter boards 'Paste a bolt onto anything' and 'The cover follows the bore'
tasks.check: the gate passes; both boards run; screenshots of each

tasks.title: The AI: FOR-AI's rule to mate by joints and imprints; assert nodes; its replies lead with what fails; a shadow board published only when its checks pass
tasks.check: on the AI's evaluation set, placements are made by joints and fewer are wrong than at the baseline (spec 00, S5)

tasks.title: The interfaces evaluation set: the twelve cases of design §4, numbers worked out by hand from the sources first
tasks.check: the set exists with its expected numbers and sources before I5 is built; it runs in the gate

tasks.title: Drag to imprint in the 3D view: the negative shown before cutting (remove, keep, contact), its verdict, accept or cancel; copy and paste a face's interface
tasks.check: in the browser: a bolt dragged onto a plate shows its negative and verdict, cuts on accept, cancels on Esc; screenshots; the blind check names what it shows

tasks.title: The rest of R18 by the same model: bearing (housing and shaft), dowel, key and keyways, pipe thread, panel cut-out
tasks.owner: interfaces.ts (data only: no code for one kind of thing)
tasks.check: evaluation cases 6, 11, 12 and a pipe thread and a cut-out pass; the diff adds data rows, not code paths per kind
